events.title: Tupac Shakur's legacy
events.blurb: On this day, we remember the tragic passing of influential rapper Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Remembering an icon
angles.copy: Thirty years on, Tupac Shakur's music and message continue to resonate. What's your favourite track from the legend?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: The music world remembers the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day.

angles.name: Guitar legend
angles.copy: Jimi Hendrix – a true pioneer whose sound changed music forever. We're celebrating his groundbreaking influence today.

events.title: Abbey Road's anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic album
angles.copy: That famous zebra crossing! The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' turns another year older. What's your go-to track from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the distinctive voice and frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock icon birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Her powerful voice and attitude have defined generations of rock.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock star birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the legendary Liam Gallagher! Forever bringing that rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: Imagine's anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: A song for peace
angles.copy: Forty-one years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A powerful message that still resonates today.

events.title: The iPod's 25th anniversary
events.blurb: Apple released the first-generation iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Tech that changed music
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? The original iPod turns 25! It completely changed how we listen to music. What was on your first iPod?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Licence to thrill
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, what's your favourite thing about 007?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Lennon's enduring spirit
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're celebrating the life and music of John Lennon. His vision continues to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy legend's birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is timeless. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The White Album anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: A diverse masterpiece
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years of 'The White Album'! The Beatles' most eclectic work. What tracks stand out to you?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Forever a champion
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled showmanship and vocal power of Freddie Mercury. His legacy with Queen lives on.

events.title: Rubber Soul's anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Changing the game
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' turns another year older! A pivotal album that pushed boundaries. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the tragic passing of music icon John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's lasting impact
angles.copy: Forty-six years since we lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally.
